title: Retain the real prepared-spill owner fusion variant
question: Can a real pre-admitted spill owner repair the observation-only race while retaining useful pass reduction?
summary: The revised private owner repairs the fixed counterexample and retains scoped benefit and acceptance; production integration remains separate.

workloads: Fixed 20k peer/cancellation controls and 200k no-peer native cost panel.
Resident and external wide-record controls; persistent Chrome events-transfer and spill failure cases.

validation.summary: Scoped exact CSV/Analysis, field/group/cap, cancellation, partial owner, external-wide and spill-write failure controls pass on their recorded runtimes. Chrome checks apply to the changed real-owner variant.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
An extra live path/file and 64-KiB buffer may reduce construction or competitor admissibility and create unused files.
No universal shared-pressure completion or production execution-graph integration is established.
exclusions: Observation-only speed samples are not pooled with changed-owner measurements.
Diagnostic API/sort clocks and acceptance durations are excluded from speed inference.
reopen_when: A promotion proposal needs separately reviewed execution integration and remaining resource/pressure feasibility, using the stronger current baseline.
